_comment: Apps named by hand for requests in words (eval android --ask, eval serve): by package, the name a person calls it (label, in place of the one its APK gives) and whether each game starts from no data (clear: pm clear, which also forgets progress and sign-ins). hide: an app installed on the demo's device that is not a game, left out of the apps a request is read against, so nobody who comes in by the link can choose it.
